_meta.purpose: Local cache of ARC Raiders item names confirmed via MetaForge's live item search/autocomplete. Grows incrementally — only add an entry after it has been seen verbatim in the site's own autocomplete results. Never hand-type an item here from memory/guessing.
_meta.fields: name = exact string accepted by MetaForge's item search. category = optional freeform hint (blueprint/resource/gear/etc). seenAt = ISO date first confirmed.
